# Proto Documentation & Knowledge Base
> Official user guide and reference for Proto Protocol on Robinhood Chain.

Proto is a decentralized, non-custodial crypto launchpad on Robinhood Chain (L2). It allows anyone to launch fixed-supply tokens, trade on interactive bonding curves or Uniswap V3 pools, and participate in fair launches with permanently locked liquidity.

## Protocol Key Parameters
- Network: Robinhood Chain (Chain ID: 4663)
- Token Supply: Fixed 1,000,000,000 (18 decimals)
- Launch Fee: 0.0005 ETH
- Graduation Target (v2): 4.2 ETH
- Fee Split: 70% Creator / 30% Protocol
- Automated Buyback & Burn: 80% of protocol fees burned
